summary: Approved Huel: Danone’s completed acquisition is confirmed by its September 4, 2026 press release, and the resulting ownership chain is supported by regulatory evidence. Rejected the remaining candidates because they are pending or do not meet the list’s consumer-brand scope.

approved_deals.direct_owner: Huel Limited (controlled by Danone Holdings (UK) Limited)
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Danone completed its acquisition of Huel, the UK functional-nutrition brand, on September 4, 2026.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Danone’s completion announcement confirms the acquisition and says Huel is consolidated in Danone’s financial statements. The UK Competition and Markets Authority identifies Danone Holdings (UK) as the acquirer of Huel Limited; Austrian competition-authority material identifies Danone Holdings (UK) as a wholly owned Danone S.A. subsidiary.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Consumer-facing UK brand; completed acquisition confirmed by an issuer press release; the operating company and ultimate owner are supported by regulatory and official evidence.

sources.title: Danone completes its acquisition of Huel, extending its portfolio in Functional Nutrition
sources.summary: Danone announced that it had successfully completed its acquisition of Huel on September 4, 2026, and that Huel would be consolidated in Danone’s financial statements from September 1, 2026.
